author: recovery-coordinator
evidence: Use the existing compiler and source APIs; the retained census is a scheduling seed, not a current claim or acceptance report.

Inspect groups of at most24 functions for at most five minutes per group; at most3 evidence-backed candidate compile attempts per function and unchanged source/compiler context. Failed candidate compiles count. Baseline, replica and deliberate damage controls are separate.

Read source, Git history, task decisions and retained attempts before retrying. Unchanged exhausted contexts get no new retry; advance and explain. Normalize relocations, member displacements and output-slot dataflow before inferring a semantic defect.

Preserve original undefined/error paths. No guards, zeroing, clamps, original-executable forwarders, asm or copied machine code. Names and type/layout changes need evidence. Ask coordinator for scope expansion before editing outside listed files or adding original identities.

No Git mutations or record/claim publication by workers. Never edit ORIGINAL markers, claim tokens or source-run logs. Coordinator reviews and banks measured claims. Keep discoveries and candidate evidence under ignored run paths.

One coordinator-provisioned fresh prefix is assigned exclusively. Lease through native resource_environment using the supplied ignored one-slot configuration; prepare before measuring, never regenerate recipes during a measurement. No nested allocations or other prefix use. Positive known Net631BA0 control must pass before candidate compilation.

All work is isolated. Preserve new behavior implementations and justified structural migrations even on matching regressions; report them for coordinator review, never silently discard. A compiling body and a scoped pass do not establish full game acceptance.
intent: Recover faithful ordinary C++ and inexpensive matches for the complete assigned owner batch; preserve justified structural discoveries and original error behavior.
